investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Helix Analytics; Platform: bare-metal Kubernetes cluster bm-prod (on-premises, 24 workers), node range 10.60.0.0/16 (racks R20-R24); Workloads: Spark-on-Kubernetes batch ETL orchestrated by etl-scheduler, and a Trino query service used by report-portal; Hardware telemetry: IPMI SEL and EDAC kernel messages are forwarded to Elasticsearch; Change management: CHG- (software) and DC- (data-center) identifiers.
